description: This file is a PHP class that implements a menu configurator for the 'TerminationReason' feature within the OrangeHRM Pim module. It overrides the screen for termination reasons view.

classes.name: TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class implementing MenuConfigurator to set up menu options related to termination reasons, overriding the screen view.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen for termination reasons within the menu configuration using a helper method.
